classification: exploratory engineering/interface feasibility; not SQL or JOIN accuracy evidence
question: Can the pinned official G-reasoner-34M execute a small synthetic schema-like graph with 1024-dimensional features, and does it consume FK-instance/composite-key metadata?
hypothesis: The model will accept a five-node synthetic graph and return finite per-node scores; source inspection predicts custom FK-instance metadata and edge_attr do not affect the model output.

success_criteria.G0_A: Pinned checkpoint loads with feature/input dimensions 1024 and 34640897 parameters; output shape is [1,5] and all values are finite.
success_criteria.G0_B: PyG transfer retains all 8 directed edges, parallel relation roles, and ordered two-component composite-FK instance metadata.
success_criteria.G0_C: Record exact equality and max absolute output delta after changing only edge_attr and custom FK metadata; delta <= 1e-6 counts as unchanged to allow minor floating-point reduction noise.
success_criteria.stop: Stop after the single paired run; preserve and report any failure without fixture repair or retry.

environment.selection_policy: Recheck nvidia-smi immediately before launch; select one sufficiently free RTX 4090.

implementation.code_changes: Add a standalone synthetic experiment runner; do not modify upstream model code.
